delta.comment: BLOCKED BY OPEN P1 (F16) — DO NOT EXECUTE AS WRITTEN. This task's rollback requirements are mutually exclusive: it mandates that NO legacy shell policy survive in the shim (also hard DoD #2) while simultaneously mandating an AUTOHARNESS_SUPERVISOR=0 escape hatch that executes the legacy inline path WITHOUT a redeploy. A runtime branch into the legacy path requires that path to be present in the shipped shim, which is exactly the duplication forbidden. A git SHA is documentation and cannot supply a runtime branch. Raised by PR #325 Copilot review on HEAD 48368657, after the 3-cycle plan-review budget was exhausted; recorded OPEN and escalated rather than absorbed. Resolution is an operator product decision between Option A (drop the escape hatch; rollback = documented single-file revert per shim incl. templates/ copies; preserves DoD #2; requires redeploy to roll back during S3 bake) and Option B (retain a versioned legacy implementation the shim dispatches to; relaxes DoD #2 and the no-duplication invariant; requires amending the plan, hardening doc, 120.007-T and 120.008-T). Contradiction originates upstream in the plan (§9, §10 T18) and hardening (H8 T18 row, H10 S3), not only in this task, and propagates to 120.008-T. Containment: 120.007-T and 120.008-T are members of 129-S (final shipment, gated behind 127-S and 128-S), so the eligible cursor 127-S is unaffected. Must be dispositioned before 129-S is claimed. See docs/reviews/2026-08-09-copilot-cli-supervisor-control-plane-review.md (Cycle 4, F16).

SUPERSEDING RESOLUTION EVENT — F16 IS RESOLVED AND THIS TASK IS NOT BLOCKED (ruling D, 2026-08-12; appended in the same pass as the F17/F19/F20/F23/F24/F25/F28/F29 sweep because this log carries the identical defect — a final event that still reads as an open blocker while the live task contract has moved on). The earlier "F16 open / must not execute" event is preserved above as history and is NO LONGER THE CURRENT STATE.

CURRENT CONTRACT. The migration escape hatch is WITHDRAWN; rollback is REDEPLOY-BASED. This task does not preserve, document or depend on the withdrawn hatch.

ALSO CURRENT (ruling A, 2026-08-12): this task now asserts THREE named approved migration deltas as an explicit PLATFORM/SCENARIO MATRIX — WINDOWS_PAT_NO_GH (WINDOWS baseline 118.001-T: fatal PAT-without-gh becomes a non-fatal structured warning with no secret exposure), POSIX_ENGRAM_DATA_DIR (POSIX baseline 118.002-T: absent default becomes the shared deterministic workspace-local default, honoring a pre-set value), and POSIX_PAT_BOOTSTRAP (POSIX baseline 118.002-T: absent PAT bootstrap becomes shared PAT handling under the same non-fatal warning contract when gh is absent) — plus byte-equivalence for every unchanged scenario on every platform. This SUPERSEDES both the earlier "exactly one delta" wording and the subsequent "exactly two deltas, both landing on POSIX" wording; the latter misclassified the PAT delta as POSIX when its baseline is start.ps1 on WINDOWS.

STATUS: NOT BLOCKED. Executable as written.
